# Liberation Sans 2.1.5

Unmodified copies of `LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` and `LiberationSans-Bold.ttf`, plus the release's `LICENSE` and `AUTHORS`, from the [liberation-fonts 2.1.5 release](https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts/releases/tag/2.1.5) (`liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz`).

Copyright (c) 2012 Red Hat, Inc. (Reserved Font Name "Liberation"). Digitized data copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation (Reserved Font Names "Arimo", "Tinos", "Cousine"). Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see `LICENSE`).

`build.py` renders these fonts into the skin's pixel fonts (`apill9.ttf`, `apill11.ttf`) and title images. The generated fonts are Modified Versions under the OFL, so they keep the OFL and do not use the Reserved Font Names.
